title: The Finta Master Plan, Revealed
summary: Finta's April 2025 master plan sets out a vision for connected deal context, Aurora-assisted workflows, and expansion into trust-driven private capital markets.
body_markdown:
## A $1 Trillion Problem


Every year, more than $1 trillion is raised across private markets. Yet, countless founders, fund managers, real estate developers, and dealmakers watch their visions fade due to the number-one company killer: a lack of capital. They drown in endless spreadsheets, unproductive conversations, and disconnected workflows—spending valuable time on activities where they have the least expertise: raising capital.


This is why we started[Finta](https://finta.ai/) .


> We Are On A Mission To Unlock Capital Access For All.


We believe that combining cutting-edge technology with best practices from the world’s most successful entrepreneurs can fundamentally transform how people from any background secure the capital they need. From day one, our core principle has been to eliminate complexity from fundraising, freeing business leaders from administrative tasks so they can focus on strategy, relationships, and execution.


We have real-world success stories (see[here](https://finta.ai/case-study/moneystack) ,[here](https://finta.ai/case-study/dentite) and[here](https://finta.ai/case-study/how-finta-helped-flamingo-electric-close-its-seed-round) ) demonstrating that Finta works. Now, we’d like to share our roadmap for the future.


‍


## **Step 1: Everything in One Place**


Traditionally, raising capital involves stitching together multiple disconnected tools:


- Investor databases for leads
- Excel or Google Sheets for contact tracking
- DocSend or Drive for pitch decks and data rooms
- Wire transfers coordinated via email
- Expensive cap table management software
- A chaotic mix of emails, calls, and meetings tying it all together


This fragmented approach is tedious, stressful, and inefficient—words directly echoed by our customers—and frequently stalls deals.


Finta integrates everything into one cohesive, intelligent environment. Central to this environment is **Aurora** , our AI assistant. Aurora relies on a steady stream of timely, context-rich data to make informed decisions. Rather than simply processing spreadsheets of contacts, Aurora comprehensively understands your business, analyzing pitch decks, websites, investor histories, and real-time communications:


- **Company Context** : Aurora reviews pitch decks, websites, and key deal details to fully grasp your business.
- [Investor Intelligence](https://finta.ai/blog/finta-product-update-introducing-investor-intelligence) : We automatically prospect and enrich contacts, providing Aurora with relevant background and historical data.
- **Real-Time Awareness** : Aurora syncs emails and meetings across your funnel, enabling precise follow-ups and personalized communication. **‍**
- **Expert Knowledge** : Aurora leverages decades of private capital market data, reasoning and acting with the experience of a seasoned dealmaker.


With Finta’s unified system, AI gets **the exact right data at the exact right time** , so you can do in minutes what used to take entire teams (and endless spreadsheets) days or weeks.


We tracked over half a billion dollars in capital across more than 20,000 investors last year alone, and we’re just getting started. Finta's Intelligent Environment is the foundation that makes sophisticated deal-making not only possible, but *repeatable* —for any team, anywhere.


‍
